title: Merge dependabot PRs with fixed CI
description: Review the three open dependabot PRs, verify dependency changes do not break functionality, fix any Biome CI issues on the PR branches, and merge them after verification.
close_reason: Merged all three Dependabot PRs after fixing and verifying CI issues

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Evidence: PR #113 updates @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.143 -> 0.3.158; CI typecheck/test/smoke passed, build-test fails only npm run check because packages/core/package.json formatting was changed away from Biome output. PR #114 updates pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 -> 5.7.284 and pdfkit 0.15.2 -> 0.18.0; CI is green. PR #115 updates Biome 1.9.4 -> 2.4.16, TypeScript 5.9.3 -> 6.0.3, and @types/node 24.12.4 -> 25.9.1; CI install smoke passes, build-test fails nodeRuntimePolicy because @types/node must stay on 24.x for Node 24 runtime support.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Verification for PR #113 branch: npm run check -> exit 0; npm run typecheck -> exit 0; npm run test -> exit 0 with 899 passed, 3 skipped across 80 files. Root cause confirmed as mechanical packages/core/package.json formatting drift; fix is npm run format output only.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Evidence on PR #115: after reverting @types/node to ^24.0.0 and npm install, the nodeRuntimePolicy targeted test passes. npm run check now fails earlier because Biome 2.4.16 rejects the existing Biome 1.9.4 config schema, organizeImports key, and files.ignore key; root cause is an unmigrated Biome 2 config, not application behavior.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Merged Dependabot PRs #113, #114, and #115. #113 fixed by formatting packages/core/package.json for the SDK bump; local gates passed before push and GitHub CI/CodeQL/install-smoke were green before merge. #114 had no code changes beyond dependency update and was already green before merge. #115 fixed Node runtime policy by keeping @types/node on 24.x, migrated biome.json to Biome 2, applied Biome 2 safe import/format fixes, resolved post-merge package.json/package-lock conflicts, and passed npm run check, npm run typecheck, npm run test locally plus GitHub CI/CodeQL/install-smoke before merge. Filed follow-up loreweaver-2pu for non-failing Biome 2 unused-code warnings.
